title.hr: Posebni bitovi: setuid, setgid i sticky
title.en: Special bits: setuid, setgid and sticky

concept.hr: Proces dobiva efektivni UID vlasnika programa; u /tmp briše samo vlasnik
concept.en: A process gets the program owner’s effective UID; in /tmp only owners delete

summary.hr: Pokreni program sa setuid i gledaj stvarni i efektivni UID, pa briši u /tmp sa sticky bitom: četvrta oktalna znamenka 4 + 2 + 1, s i S, setgid na direktoriju.
summary.en: Run a setuid program and watch the real and effective UID, then delete in sticky /tmp: the fourth octal digit 4 + 2 + 1, s and S, setgid on a directory.

title.hr: Sticky bit: tko smije brisati u /tmp
title.en: Sticky bit: who may delete in /tmp

concept.hr: Pisati u /tmp smije svatko, a brisati tuđu datoteku ne: Operation not permitted
concept.en: Anyone may write in /tmp, but not delete another user’s file there

title.hr: setgid na direktoriju: grupa nove datoteke
title.en: setgid on a directory: a new file’s group

concept.hr: Datoteka nastala u /srv/projekt (2770) dobiva grupu projekt, ne grupu procesa
concept.en: A file created in /srv/projekt (2770) gets group projekt, not the process’s
